submitted.rationale: XRD shows ZnSb2O6 trirutile dominating across the composition line. Sb-rich films (idx 16, 24) show an extra phase (Q≈2.44, 3.63), which is stronger at idx 24. Illumination at 2.1 eV is below the band gap, so any response should come from defect or mixed-valence Sb states in the Sb-rich region. idx 24 had the highest measured EQE (0.0107%). idx 16 (-0.0032%) and idx 27 (-0.0002%) were at or below zero.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE -0.0002%, at noise level despite being close to idx 24 in composition
XRD shows single-phase ZnSb2O6 with no Sb-rich secondary phase; the EQE trend favoured Sb-rich films, so no merit measurement was spent
